settings.label: Mission
settings.text: 971 Threads makes heavyweight tees and hoodies for the streets of the UAE and beyond — from sands to street, built to last and designed to stand out.

settings.label: Promise
settings.text: Premium heavyweight cotton, honest pricing, and limited runs. No mass production, no filler — just fits worth wearing on repeat.

settings.label: Values
settings.text: Born in the 971 and made for the culture. We keep drops limited, quality high, and the community first.

settings.question: How long does it take for my order to arrive?
settings.answer: Orders within the UAE arrive in 1–3 business days. International orders typically take 5–10 business days depending on your location.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unworn items with tags can be returned within 14 days for an exchange or store credit. Sale and limited-drop pieces are final sale.

settings.question: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — we ship the 971 worldwide. Shipping is calculated at checkout, and free across the UAE on orders over AED 200.
